boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Howard University rites and recurring celebrations, from a first-year pinning journey to Homecoming pageantry and the graduating class’s reverse Long Walk.

cards.title: Receive the Bison Pin at Sunset
cards.subtitle: A Bison Week rite of passage in Greene Stadium
cards.notes: Follow the announced Bison Week route from the residence halls, cross The Yard, and enter Greene Stadium for the symbolic pinning.
cards.short_summary: Howard formally welcomes first-time college students into the Bison family with a sunset pinning ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard describes the Freshman Pinning Ceremony as a signature rite of passage in which first-time college students walk from their residence halls through The Yard to Greene Stadium and receive a pin.
cards.access_notes: This ceremony is intended for participating first-time college students and their families; consult the current Bison Week schedule for entry rules.

cards.title: Complete the Long Walk in Reverse
cards.subtitle: The graduating procession from Greene Stadium to The Yard
cards.notes: Watch for the graduating class’s formal route to The Yard—the symbolic reverse of the walk incoming students make before pinning.
cards.short_summary: A commencement procession closes the journey that begins with Howard’s first-year walk to Greene Stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard states that graduates process from Greene Stadium to The Yard during Commencement, reversing the incoming-freshman march from The Yard to Greene Stadium and symbolizing a completed academic journey.
cards.access_notes: The procession occurs as part of Commencement; use the current commencement site for graduate instructions and guest-entry details.

cards.title: Open the Academic Year in Convocation
cards.subtitle: A formal Howard gathering dating to the Johnson presidency
cards.notes: Consult the academic calendar for the annual convocation, then arrive under the posted entry rules to hear the opening address.
cards.short_summary: Howard begins its academic year by gathering the university community around its shared mission.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard’s president wrote that the formal Opening Convocation tradition dates back nearly a century to Mordecai Wyatt Johnson’s presidency and cited the first address on September 29, 1926.
cards.access_notes: Venue and attendance arrangements can change by year; follow the current Howard events calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Mark Howard’s Founding at Charter Day
cards.subtitle: The annual March convocation commemorating the 1867 charter
cards.notes: Look for the first-weekend-of-March convocation program, which connects Howard’s founding story with recognition of alumni achievement.
cards.short_summary: Howard commemorates its charter with an annual formal gathering rooted in more than a century of observance.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard reports that annual Charter Day celebrations date to the university’s first anniversary and traditionally include a Friday morning convocation during the first weekend of March.
cards.source_title: The Modern Evolution of Howard's Charter Day Celebrations
cards.access_notes: The convocation venue and public-access arrangements are announced annually; verify the current Charter Day program before attending.

cards.title: Bookend Homecoming with a Call to Chapel
cards.subtitle: Opening and closing worship in Howard’s Homecoming calendar
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming schedule for the opening or closing Call to Chapel and follow the listed venue, seating, and streaming guidance.
cards.short_summary: Howard frames Homecoming week with recurring chapel services that bring students and alumni together.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard’s official Homecoming FAQ identifies opening and closing Calls to Chapel among the celebration’s highlights, while Howard’s newsroom documents the recurring Homecoming Sunday service.
cards.access_notes: The service location may vary; consult the current Homecoming schedule for venue, capacity, accessibility, and livestream information.

cards.title: See the Royal Court Crowned
cards.subtitle: Homecoming pageantry for Howard’s student court
cards.notes: Use the official Homecoming calendar to locate the coronation, then follow that year’s ticketing or registration instructions.
cards.short_summary: Howard’s Homecoming opens with formal recognition and crowning of its student Royal Court.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard’s official 2025 Homecoming announcement scheduled the Royal Court Coronation on opening Sunday, and Howard Magazine lists crowning the royal court among favorite Homecoming traditions.
cards.source_title: Howard University Announces the 2025 Homecoming Theme, ‘ONE OF ONE,’ and Preliminary Schedule of Events
cards.access_notes: Date, venue, and admission arrangements are set annually; confirm them on the current official Homecoming calendar.

cards.title: Gather on The Yard for Yardfest
cards.subtitle: Howard’s signature outdoor Homecoming concert and reunion
cards.notes: Use the official event listing for dates and security rules, then enter through posted access points and keep clear of performance areas.
cards.short_summary: The Yard becomes an outdoor Homecoming stage for music, reunion, food vendors, and the Howard community.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard calls Yardfest the signature outdoor concert and celebration on The Yard and describes concert and reunion programming alongside the Sixth Street Festival.
cards.access_notes: The official FAQ says Yardfest is free, but dates, security screening, capacity, and permitted items should be checked each year.

cards.title: Watch Howard’s Divine Nine Step
cards.subtitle: A Homecoming showcase of rhythm, creativity, and fellowship
cards.notes: Check the annual Homecoming listing for the participating organizations, venue, start time, and required ticket before heading to the show.
cards.short_summary: Howard’s Greek-letter organizations bring choreographed stepping and organization pride to a recurring Homecoming stage.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard describes the annual Greek Step Show as a tradition featuring Divine Nine and other student organizations demonstrating creativity and showmanship through step.
cards.source_title: Forward! Howard University Announces 2019 Howard Homecoming Event Schedule and Theme
cards.access_notes: This is generally a ticketed Homecoming event; verify the current venue, ticket source, age policy, and entry rules before attending.

cards.title: See Student Design Take the Runway
cards.subtitle: Howard’s recurring Homecoming fashion showcase
cards.notes: Review the current Homecoming program for the venue and ticket release, then arrive according to its seating and check-in instructions.
cards.short_summary: Student designers and performers turn a Homecoming event into a recurring showcase of Howard creativity.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard Magazine identifies the student fashion show as a favorite Homecoming tradition, and Howard’s official 2025 schedule again included the event.
cards.access_notes: Venue, admission price, and access procedures vary by year; use the current official Homecoming event listing.

cards.title: Line the Route for the Homecoming Parade
cards.subtitle: Showtime, floats, and Bison spirit through the surrounding community
cards.notes: Check the published route and street restrictions, choose a lawful public viewing spot, and leave crossings and sidewalks unobstructed.
cards.short_summary: Howard carries Homecoming beyond The Yard with its marching band, dance teams, floats, and community participants.
cards.evidence_claim: Howard Alumni Relations documents the Homecoming Community Parade through Georgia Avenue and the Shaw neighborhood, featuring the Showtime Marching Band, dance teams, school bands, floats, and classic cars.
cards.source_title: Come Back for Homecoming 2025: Sensational Events Fill the Week
cards.access_notes: The route and road closures can change annually; consult the current Homecoming schedule and District transportation notices.

warnings: Opening Convocation publication date was inferred from the 2023 event context because the page exposes no clearly verified publication date; confirm before ingesting if exact dating is required.

The Greek Step Show source is older than the template freshness window, but newer official Homecoming schedules confirm that the named event continues; its tradition description comes from the direct 2019 Howard source.
Coordinates and Google Maps links are supplied only for stable named venues; event locations that vary annually are null.
All cards describe documented Howard-specific rites or recurring events. Access, ticketing, dates, and venues should be rechecked against each current annual program.
